problem:
Calculate the minor of the entry ${x}_{21}$ in the matrix
$X=[\begin{aligned}9 & -3 & 0 \\ -2 & 8 & 6 \\ -1 & 0 & 11\end{aligned}].$

examples.knowledge_point: Calculating a Minor in a 3x3 Matrix With Integer Entries
examples.problem:
Calculate the minor of the entry $b_{21}$ in the matrix
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14075201/assets/8e664813c6467d5bb06a8eb1e1d68778d3142479939624a7a46674f593d786b9.png)
examples.worked_solution:
The minor of $b_{21} = 3$ (second row, first column) is the determinant of the remaining entries when the column and row containing $3$ are removed: 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14075201/assets/a69955fcba387ef3c65f1c1529c2007d8d70f82d95738af9b995999a21198730.png)

So, the minor of $b_{21}=3$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}det[\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ 7 & 2\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ 7 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot 2-5\cdot 7 \\  & =2-35 \\  & =-33.\end{aligned}
$$
